label: preparing
what: An undisclosed plan around the missing town account figures and council records, including investigating who held them; separate documented work involved preparing/installing eight lanterns for a great hall lighting inspection. The mayor was told of/approved the lighting inspection, so that is not itself preparation hidden from the mayor. Strongest evidence of covert preparation is the secretary’s account inquiry and movements/search around the great hall records, but the record does not clearly establish a coordinated secret undertaking by two or more people unknown to the mayor.
